public_holidays: Sint Maarten's own holidays: Emancipation Day 1 July (2027: Thursday), Sint Maarten Day 11 November (2027: Thursday).
Also kept: New Year's Day, Good Friday (2027-03-26), Easter Monday (2027-03-29), King's Day 27 April, Labour Day 1 May, Ascension (2027-05-06), Christmas Day and Boxing Day.
protocol_notes: The island is shared: Sint Maarten (Dutch) and Saint-Martin (French) keep different holidays. The French side is on Saint-Martin's record.

items.text: Sint Maarten is a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands with its own criminal code and drug law, separate from the Dutch Opium Act. Dutch coffeeshop rules do not apply by default. Penalties and cannabis rules have not been read from Sint Maarten's own legislation.
